newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Buffets estimates cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Buffets estimates cut.

text.p: -- EVEREN Securities analyst Dean Haskell said Friday he cut his earnings estimate for Buffets Inc to $0.10 a share from $0.14 for the fourth quarter. This brings his earnings estimate for all of 1996 to $0.60 a share
-- He also cut his earnings estimate for Buffets for 1997 to $0.55 a share from $0.75.

-- Earlier, Buffets said it expects its fourth quarter results will be substantially below analysts' consensus expectations and fourth quarter 1995 results. The First Call consensus for the fourth quarter was $0.17 a share.

-- Buffets earned $0.19 a share in the fourth quarter of 1995. Haskell said the year-ago results will be restated to $0.18 a share for the inclusion of the operations of HomeTown Buffet Inc. That merger was completed in September, 1996.
-- Haskell said he expects Buffets' results will continue to be affected by higher food and labor costs, as well as higher fixed costs as a percentage of sales.
-- He said higher food and labor costs result from training and the roll-out of a new menu.

-- Asked about the Buffets-HomeTown merger, Haskell said he believes the deal is in the best interest of the restaurant-operator company in the long run. "But there are some hiccups right now," he said. "It took longer to get connected than they expected."
-- He continues to have a market perform rating on the stock.
